name: trace line method
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 文中确定轮轨接触几何关系的方法。
usage_note: 方法语境为轮轨几何，不能与其他学科同名迹线方法自动归为同义。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道系统的轮轨空间接触几何求解，确定接触位置及相关几何参数。此处指轮轨几何分析中的方法，应与其他学科的同名方法区分。

complete_examples.text: Geometrically, the wheel-rail space contact relationship is determined by the "trace line method" [1].
Moreover, for the wheel-rail geometric relationship, a simplified and efficient method has been proposed by Wang et al. [25,26], it is the well-known “trace line method”.
The “trace line method [25,26]” is used for depicting the wheel-rail geometric relationship.

In this work, the trace line method is used to determine the geometric rela tionship between the wheel and rail, the normal force of the wheel-rail contact is obtained by the nonlinear Hertz contact theory (Zhai, 2015), and the modified saturated creep theory is employed to calculate the tangential force (Shen et al., 1983; Zhai, 2015).
